findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: filings_list, filing_get, proof_get, filing_document, issuer_releases, call_materials, fund_letters · Private data: company_lookup, filings_list, filing_get, verify_value, compare_versions, institutional_holders, institutional_holdings, stock_prices, dividends, company_kpis, company_estimates, identifiers, company_logo, filing_document, filing_search, call_materials, call_material, politician_trades, fund_letters, forward_ratios, pre_ipo_companies, pre_ipo_company, ask_company · Public sink: company_profile, financials_standardized, ratios, ratios_daily, filing_facts, changes_since, institutional_holders, stock_prices, dividends, fund_profile, company_estimates, corporate_actions, fund_nav, coverage, issuer_releases, forward_ratios · Destructive: proof_get, filing_document, screen_natural_language.
